FOREWORD This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards after the draft finalized by the Sewing Machines Sectional Committee had been approved by the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This standard has been prepared to rationalize for manufacturing in economic quantities. the type and sizes of sewing machine components

This standard was first printed

in 1985 and the present revision has been undertaken to modify the figures SO as to facilitate the measurement of the various parts and also to harmonize the standard with the revision of IS 4188 : 1967 `Oscillating shafts for sewing machines for household purposes' ( under preparation ).

be referred. A list of Indian Standards

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with. the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised )`. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

ANNEX A ( Clause 7 )
SCALE A-l SCALE A-l.1 Lot A-2.1 The shuttle driver selected according to A-l.2 and A-l.3 or A-l.4 shall be examined for dimensions and tolerances ( see 5 ) and workmanship and finish ( see 6 1. If number of shuttle driver failing to meet one or more of the requirements mentioned above is less than or equal to the permissible number of defectives given in co1 3 of Table I, the lot shall be declared as conforming to the requirements of these characteristics. A-2.2 In the case of those lots which have been found satisfactory according to A-2.1, a number of shuttle driver equal to the sample size indicated in col 4 of Table 1, shall be subjected to hardness test ( see 4 ). Any shuttle driver failing to meet the requirements of hardness shall be considered to be defective. A-2.2.1 if no defectives are found among the shuttle driver subjected to the hardness test ( see A-2.2 ), the lot shall be declared as conforming to the requirements of the specification otherwise not. OF SAMPLING AND CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY TESTS AND CRITERIA

OF SAMPLING

A-2 NUMBER OF FOR CONFORMITY

In any consignment, all the shuttle driver of same type and manufactured from the same material under essentially similar conditions of manufacture shall be grouped together to constitute a lot. A-l.2 For ascertaining the conformity of the lot to the requirements of specification, tests shall be carried out for each lot separately. The number of shuttle driver to be selected at random for this purpose shall be in accordance with co1 1 and 2 of Table 1. A-l.3 If the shuttle drivers are packed individually, in order to ensure the randomness of selection, IS 4905 : 1968 shall be used. A-l.4 If the shuttle drivers are packed in different cartons ( not less than 20 percent of the total in the lot subject to minimum of 2 ) shall be chosen at random. From each of the cartons so chosen, an approximately equal number of shuttle driver shall be picked up from its different parts so as to obtain the required number of shuttle driver specified in co1 2 of Table 1.
